---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

This page explores how James Bond film revenues have changed over time.

::: {#9044cb5d .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```
:::


The James Bond films in this dataset span from 1995 to 2021.

::: {#cell-fig-bond-revenue .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue")
plt.title("James Bond Revenue Over Time")
plt.show()
```
